[[File:EnergyCell-WotC.png|200px|thumb|An energy cell.]]
'''Energy cell''' is a generic term used for small, portable, rechargeable power sources usually in the shape of a flat disk.

==Description==
Power cells were small [[Battery/Legends|batteries]], often in the shape of a small flat disc. They were used to power a variety of devices, including some type of weapon. They were virtually weightless and cost only ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

They were used in almost every device that uses energy, from [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. There were various types of energy cells, including some variants that employed [[Diatium/Legends|diatium]]. The most efficient energy cells contained complex circuitry to ensure optimal energy delivery.

==History==
Energy cells have been in use since at least the [[Jedi Civil War]] and continued to be used, albeit with modifications and upgrades, as late as [[130 ABY]].
